blocks.text: Interior Design Service Prices — DUMSKAYA DESIGN, Bratislava

parts.html: We create modern, well-planned interiors with a focus on aesthetics, functionality, and quality of implementation. Choose the package that best matches your property, project needs, and required level of support.

blocks.text: Express Interior Design Package — €20/m² Completion time — from 14 days after layout approval.

parts.html: A fast and practical solution for apartments, houses, and commercial spaces that are already ready for finishing works and do not require an extended set of technical documentation.
The package includes a measured floor plan, a functional furniture layout, and photorealistic 3D visualizations of each main room, with one round of revisions included.
You can see the future interior in advance and evaluate the layout, combination of materials, furniture, lighting, and color solutions before finishing works begin.
The Express Package is ideal for clients who want to receive a professional interior concept and a clear visual basis for further project implementation within a short timeframe.
Price: €20/m²
Minimum package price — €1,500
Interior Design Package “Furniture” — €35-€45/m²

An ideal solution for apartments, houses, and commercial spaces that are already ready for furnishing. The package includes a detailed measurement plan, furniture layout plan, photorealistic 3D visualizations of each room with one round of revisions, and a complete set of furniture drawings for custom-made furniture production.
You receive a complete interior concept and a technical specification for the production of custom kitchens, wardrobes, walk-in closets, built-in storage systems, and other bespoke cabinetry.
Price: €35–45/m²
Minimum package price: €2,000
Furniture production, delivery, and installation based on the developed project are also available.

parts.html: An optimal solution for apartments, houses, and commercial spaces where a complete interior design project with visualizations and a full set of technical documentation is required for renovation works.

The package includes a measured floor plan, furniture layout, demolition and construction plans, layouts for plumbing fixtures, underfloor heating, sockets, switches, electrical points, lighting and ceilings, as well as flooring plans, wall elevations for bathrooms and kitchens, specifications, and schedules of finishing materials.
Photorealistic 3D visualizations are developed for each room, with one round of revisions included.
You receive a complete interior concept and a set of technical drawings required by the construction team for accurate implementation of the approved design.
Price: €35-€45/m²
Minimum package price — €2,000
Additional services can include design supervision, preparation of a detailed renovation cost estimate, project procurement and furnishing, custom-made furniture, and turnkey renovation.

items.text: View an example of work with technical documentation

parts.html: An extended solution for apartments, houses, and commercial spaces where a highly detailed interior design project and professional support during preparation for renovation are required.

The package includes the complete basic set of technical drawings, wall elevations for all rooms, detailed construction nodes and sections, specifications and calculations of key materials, as well as photorealistic 3D visualizations of each room with up to two rounds of revisions.
The package also includes two joint visits with the designer to select finishing materials, helping ensure that the approved interior concept is implemented more accurately.
You receive a thoroughly developed interior design project with extended technical documentation required for precise implementation and more effective control of renovation works.
Price: €50/m²
Minimum package price — €2,500
Our most comprehensive package for clients who want a highly detailed interior and professional project support throughout the implementation stage.
The package includes all Premium services, plus 2 months of design supervision, custom furniture drawings, complete specifications of finishing materials, and schedules for all interior items.
You receive not only a complete interior design project, but also extended documentation and designer support required for the most accurate implementation of the approved concept.
Price: €70/m²
Minimum package price — €3,500
